     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→The current password policy only requires a minimum of 6 characters (app/(auth)/register/page.tsx line 68, app/(auth)/login/page.tsx line 88). This is below industry standards and makes user accounts vulnerable to brute-force and dictionary attacks.
     6→
     7→## Rationale
     8→
     9→OWASP and NIST guidelines recommend stronger password requirements. A 6-character password can be cracked in seconds with modern tools. Weak passwords are one of the most common causes of account compromise in SaaS applications.
